finding: reference_offset_ns is a caller-supplied integer that directly participates in reference_time_ns and therefore cross-source admissibility, but the merged TemporalPerceptRef has no required calibration/synchronization evidence identity, calibration generation, reference-clock identity, validity interval, or offset-evidence digest. clock_domain is persisted but does not by itself authorize or validate the supplied offset. Consequently ALIGNED/CURRENT is evidence-bounded to the caller's numeric normalization assertion, not to independently bound clock-synchronization provenance.

source_counterexample.observed_contract_behavior: The repository test test_reference_clock_offset_enables_bounded_cross_host_join requires both refs to be CURRENT/ALIGNED. The same API permits the remote offset value to be supplied without a machine-enforced calibration provenance object.
source_counterexample.falsified_stronger_interpretation: ObservationWindow.alignment_status=ALIGNED cannot be interpreted as proof that distinct clock domains were actually synchronized to the claimed offset.

relevance: Distributed robotics timing assumes synchronized clocks when accurate event timestamps are required.
ROS time can jump and explicitly requires handling time-source discontinuities rather than assuming monotonic continuity.
Different time abstractions have compatibility constraints; clock identity therefore carries semantic weight beyond a numeric timestamp.

not_claimed: No claim is made that the current component CI is invalid at its declared source/unit scope.
No claim is made that every caller will provide a false offset; the gap is that the contract does not machine-bind the offset to evidence.

recommended_native_repair.admission_rule: A non-zero or cross-domain reference offset may affect CURRENT/ALIGNED only when bound to exact, non-stale ClockAlignmentEvidence whose offset/uncertainty/clock identities match the TemporalPerceptRef. Missing, stale, mismatched or superseded alignment evidence yields UNALIGNED rather than caller-normalized CURRENT.
recommended_native_repair.time_jump_rule: Clock reset/jump or alignment-generation change invalidates prior cross-domain normalization until re-established.
recommended_native_repair.same_domain_fast_path: Same-domain observations may use the native clock relation without manufacturing cross-domain calibration evidence, subject to existing freshness/uncertainty rules.

trigger4_falsifiers: Cross-domain ref with arbitrary offset and no calibration evidence must be UNALIGNED.
Correct offset but stale calibration generation must be UNALIGNED.
Correct numeric offset with wrong source/reference clock-domain binding must be rejected.
Clock-jump/new epoch must invalidate old alignment evidence.
Changing only untrusted reference_offset_ns must not convert an otherwise UNALIGNED pair into ALIGNED.
downstream_note: F2-WP-712 is building a typed PerceptionWorldBridge with exact time/provenance identity. Before stronger bridge/runtime credit, its temporal provenance should not treat an unbound WP-711 reference offset as authenticated clock-alignment evidence.
